params.body:
Two things in one pull request.

**The gateway decides by the book.** The DMN evaluator moves to bextrust/control (`rules`, `feel`), so the gateway and the book's own tests share one implementation. `book.Decision` is now `rules.Table`. `rulebook/book.json` gains `policy_decisions`, which says which decisions govern which system (crm: L1, L2; github: L4). `TestTheGatewayDecidesAsTheBook` checks that the gateway reaches the same outcome as the book on every case.

**A fresh clone builds.** `go.mod` replaces now point to `../control`, the same layout as the GitHub org. Prose and cases name `bextrust/control` and `bextrust/crm`. A new `README.md` is the starting point for the five repositories: what each holds, how to clone, build, test and run locally, and what is built or not yet. `docs/hosting-lessons.md` keeps what an earlier staging attempt taught.

Merge this before the crm `lean` PR, which needs `book.Decision` as a pointer.
params.title: The gateway decides by the book; a fresh clone builds
